title: Prove exact two-channel P104 support 72 over F3 and Q (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove the exact second generalized support weight of the specified P104 root code:

```text
d_2(C over F3) = d_2(C over Q) = 72
704 minimizing ternary two-dimensional subcodes
```

This is a finite certificate with a scoped proof. Two independent channels need a union of at least 72 ports, with an explicit attaining pair. Combined with Matarener's cited PR6166 hyperplane capacity 60, a common acquisition frame must be FULL; a common landing frame for independent receiver columns satisfying the same code hypothesis must be ZERO. Asynchronous relays and larger codes remain open. No new kappa, physical supplier or selected-frontier change is claimed.

The contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Matarener PR6166 for the code identification, coordinate fixture and cited capacity; Ali Romman PR5827 and DreamingOfClouds PR5907/6030 for the retained P104 lineage, with their native/helper/controller/compiler predecessors. Generalized Hamming weights and the minor argument are standard.

## Evidence

- Before: PR6166 supplies the single-channel support result. It does not compute this joint-support invariant.
- After: all 3,280 projective codewords and 5,377,560 distinct projective pairs are enumerated exactly. The minimum is 72. Grouping the 4,224 minimizing pairs gives 704 planes, each represented by exactly six pairs.
- The eight-row generator is systematic on the declared clique. Its 832 entries agree with separate explicit rational-root and intersection formulas. The rational witness has weights 49 and 71, its ternary reduction has weights 49 and 69, and both unions are the same 72-coordinate set. A written rank-reduction proof supplies the rational lower bound.
- Registered warning-strict normal and optimized checks, direct replay, metadata/pins, committed bytes/modes and source-history preflight pass. The two registered checks took 0.553 s and 0.548 s in individual local timed runs, below their 120 s limits. No runtime improvement is claimed.
- Official export integrity and both Git-free read-only replays pass. All nine exported files, including the export receipt, retain their bytes and modes.
- The generated RESULT.json binds all seven proof/input/metadata files and records the complete histogram and witness. Changed source bytes, zero/dependent projective inputs and incorrect receipts reject under optimized Python too.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/p104-two-channel-support/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/p104-two-channel-support/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-two-channel-support
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-two-channel-support --check-source-history
```

Expected markers are `PASS_P104_TWO_CHANNEL_SUPPORT d2=72 pairs=5377560 minimizing_subcodes=704`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Any CPython 3.12 installation can replace the local path; no third-party dependencies are required.

Base and publication ancestry pin canonical main `3f0152a32eeebac0df11946dbd50cabe5a7f7839`, priority revision 8. The external PR6166 coordinate source is pinned at `096938513138868f0ed27639061f1a5054900f96` by URL and byte hash. That open head is outside publication ancestry. The generic source-history pass covers the canonical catalogue and selected record, not the external head. The retained coordinate bytes make direct replay self-contained.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

PR6166's uniqueness and capacity results are cited, not re-verified. The common-frame implications require the specified code reduction and genuinely common acquisition or landing frames. No cost for independently scheduled channels is inferred. Arbitrary nine-dimensional codes, overcomplete canceling carriers and public relays are outside the result. No native, complete caller, restoration, stock/precision, compiler, outer, selected-word or Lean replay is performed. This is not a complete multiplication theorem. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

- Can two asynchronously acquired/delivered channels escape the common-frame constraint with a favorable complete invoice? Start with explicit independent rows, chronological cuts and all frame/restoration charges. The actual physical caller is missing.
- What joint-support bound holds for a specified nine-dimensional decoding code outside the minimal-code reduction? First provide the code and a legal pair of delivered channels. No larger-code census is supplied here.

## Related open work

- #6166 identifies this ternary P104 code and supplies the cited single-channel/capacity results. This adds its second support weight and rational lift; it does not audit the predecessor.
- #6144 changes owned-register relay descent on the P104 word. This changes no word or invoice and does not exclude its separately scheduled relays.
- #6167 retains an operand to remove a P104 root stop. This is a code-support obstruction under common-frame hypotheses, without a competing price computation.
- #6169 resynthesizes P104 scalar events while retaining the invoice. This leaves every scalar program unchanged.
- #6170 supplies P104 design/pricing tools. This standalone exact support certificate invokes none of those tools or word optimizers.
- #6171 reduces tensor frames with fixed productive boundaries. This studies independent supports within a specified code and makes no tensor-moment optimality claim.
- #6172 studies a signed tensor gap with variable target boundaries. This fixes the code space and computes no signed-moment optimum.
- #5606 prepares a split helper and changes its paid/target bill. This supplies no preparation word or invoice change.
- #5553 changes two helper handoffs on an earlier P104 word. This does not change or audit those lifetimes.

Live main README, merged-PR, open-PR and Discussion searches found no same-question result within their coverage. The overlap helper reports complete remote pagination and incomplete sparse local-note coverage; separate Git searches cover main's README inventory. Unpublished work and literature-wide novelty are not certified. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19267579).
